name: Pack Attack [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You are skilled at surrounding your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): When you are adjacent to an ally, the first time you melee attack an opponent, your ally can spend an immediate action to take a 5-foot step, even if they have otherwise moved this round.

Normal: You can take a 5-foot step only if you have not otherwise moved in a round.

Special: Animal companions may take this feat.
